enforcement: REAL ID enforcement began on May 7, 2025.
minimum_docs: At a minimum, you must provide documentation showing: 1) Full Legal Name; 2) Date of Birth; 3) Social Security Number; 4) Two Proofs of Address of Principal Residence; and 5) Lawful Status.
noncompliant_ok: REAL ID allows jurisdictions to issue identification cards and driver's licenses that are not in compliance with the requirements of the Act.
noncompliant_mark: Those licenses and identification cards, however, must clearly state on their face and in the machine readable zone that the card is not acceptable for official purposes.
edl_states: Currently there are only 5 states that issue EDL/EIDs, Michigan, Minnesota, New York, Vermont, and Washington.
not_border: REAL ID cards cannot be used for border crossings into Canada, Mexico or other international travel.
not_cruise: REAL ID cards cannot be used for international sea cruise travel.
